character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A hulking goblin chieftain, huge and muscular, broad shoulders, thick arms, roaring with tusked teeth, long pointed ears, olive green skin. Carries an enormous maul over its shoulder: a heavy square stone head banded in brass with a glowing violet rune carved on it, a long wooden haft wrapped in leather. Wears a necklace of small bones and skulls, a wide leather belt with a brass gear-wheel buckle, a ragged cape of furs and torn deep blue academy banners with gold stars, leather bracers, bare feet. Warm earthy colours: olive green skin, brown leather and fur, brass, grey stone, deep blue cloth. Detailed pixel art, dark outline.
